scope: Provisional-ID agentic question planning from permitted versioned inventory metadata. Original fixture/answer content is not used.

source.inspection_limit: Question proposals use the inventory endpoint-stage review; original full prompt, output and method limits remain attached. No new runtime or source-data validation implied.

defaults.authoring_unit: One coherent question on independently observed biological inputs; combine bookkeeping and component summaries into its connected analysis.
defaults.required_before_implementation: Freeze independent source lineage, biological sample structure, exact input boundary, method versions, complete artifact schemas and deterministic acceptance. Keep corpus train-only and expected solve time <=30 minutes.
defaults.native_reference: Reference scripts execute the actual required packages; private oracles read supplied inputs. Independently verify identities, algebraic invariants and all required artifacts. No LLM-as-a-judge.
defaults.learned_output_acceptance: Grade complete finite predictions against private observed labels with a frozen metric/criterion. Accept equivalent cluster/topic label permutations. Model uncertainty and counterfactual claims require endpoint-specific checks.
defaults.runtime_boundary: For long original pipelines, explicitly choose a bounded observed-data start boundary. Precomputed alignments or counts cover downstream analysis only; do not claim full raw-data pipeline coverage. GPU/weight-dependent methods and large reference resources remain feasibility questions.
defaults.consolidation: Review overlaps with earlier question cards before implementation. Distinct assays, statistical estimands and named native methods cannot be silently substituted.

observed_input_requirements: Observed expression or multiomic matrices with biological sample identities, condition labels and frozen annotations.
source_specific_decisions: Use stable factor equivalence and preserve gene IDs; factor rotations/order cannot be graded as exact array identities.
proposed_artifact_requirements: Feature eligibility, loadings/modules, complete per-feature scores, sample-level validation, gene-set memberships and null statistics
deterministic_verifier_design: Independent feature score, correlation and enrichment arithmetic plus native model references; test subspaces and reconstructed data rather than arbitrary factor labels.

questions.scientific_question: Which observed genes lead multinomial-deviance rankings, and how do count-aware components differ from transformed-count PCA?
required_endpoint_stages: fit count-aware components or null residuals
observed_input_requirements: Observed count matrix with feature identities, mitochondrial annotation, sample/batch labels and QC metadata; native H5AD/Matrix Market inputs.
source_specific_decisions: Declare likelihood and library-size offsets; do not substitute transformed variance for count deviance.
proposed_artifact_requirements: H5AD layers, cell/feature inclusion tables, normalization factors, PCA loadings, neighbor graph, cluster and QC tables
deterministic_verifier_design: Check counts and sparse shapes, sample joins and exclusion arithmetic; verify subspaces/graphs up to appropriate symmetries, not exact UMAP coordinates; use observed labels only where supported.

questions.scientific_question: Which genes vary along an observed-data trajectory under a prespecified representation and association model?
observed_input_requirements: Observed developmental or perturbation time course with biological replication; spliced/unspliced counts or lineage evidence only for endpoints requiring them.
source_specific_decisions: Avoid reprocessing an already transformed layer; account for trajectory reversal and cell identity.
proposed_artifact_requirements: State graph, root evidence, pseudotime/fate matrices, full gene/regulon tests, biological-validation tables
deterministic_verifier_design: Verify graph/ordering invariants and native outputs with seeded tolerances; independently check associations with held-out observed time/lineage evidence; do not grade causality from expression.

questions.scientific_question: Which ligand hypotheses explain independently observed receiver-cell responses under a frozen ligand-target prior and expressed-gene background?
required_endpoint_stages: link ligand, receptor and target evidence
observed_input_requirements: Observed PDB/mmCIF structures with biological assembly, ligand identity, alternate locations, protonation assumptions and measured affinity where available.
source_specific_decisions: Preserve receiver-specific gene universe and contrast identity; prior-supported ligand activity does not prove signaling causality.
proposed_artifact_requirements: Native structures, ligand/residue mapping, atom/contact tables, descriptor/ranking outputs and assay comparison
deterministic_verifier_design: Independent coordinate/contact calculations and native structural parsing; distinguish a docking score from measured affinity; deterministic invariants for equivalent atom ordering.
